mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation_requests ( reservation_id, member_id, request_type, request_reason, requested_reservation_date, requested_people_count, requested_course_name, requested_remarks, status, refund_status, admin_comment ) VALUES ( #{reservationId}, #{memberId}, #{requestType}, #{requestReason}, #{requestedReservationDate}, #{requestedPeopleCount}, #{requestedCourseName}, #{requestedRemarks}, #{status}, #{refundStatus}, #{adminComment} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, reservation_id, member_id, request_type, request_reason, requested_reservation_date, requested_people_count, requested_course_name, requested_remarks, status, refund_status, admin_comment, created_at, processed_at FROM reservation_requests WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, reservation_id, member_id, request_type, request_reason, requested_reservation_date, requested_people_count, requested_course_name, requested_remarks, status, refund_status, admin_comment, created_at, processed_at FROM reservation_requests ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, reservation_id, member_id, request_type, request_reason, requested_reservation_date, requested_people_count, requested_course_name, requested_remarks, status, refund_status, admin_comment, created_at, processed_at FROM reservation_requests WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, reservation_id, member_id, request_type, request_reason, requested_reservation_date, requested_people_count, requested_course_name, requested_remarks, status, refund_status, admin_comment, created_at, processed_at FROM reservation_requests WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'PENDING' LIMIT 1

SELECT rr.id, rr.reservation_id, rr.member_id, rr.request_type, rr.request_reason, rr.requested_reservation_date, rr.requested_people_count, rr.requested_course_name, rr.requested_remarks, rr.status, rr.refund_status, rr.admin_comment, rr.created_at, rr.processed_at,
r.reservation_date, r.people_count, r.representative_name, r.phone_number, r.course_name, r.status AS reservation_status,
m.name AS member_name, m.email AS member_email
FROM reservation_requests rr INNER JOIN reservations r ON rr.reservation_id = r.id INNER JOIN members m ON rr.member_id = m.id WHERE rr.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY rr.created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation_requests WHERE status = 'PENDING'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation_requests WHERE request_type = 'CANCEL' AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.update: UPDATE reservation_requests SET status = #{status}, refund_status = #{refundStatus}, admin_comment = #{adminComment}, processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation_requests WHERE status = 'PENDING'
